generalCriterionList.description: Intending bidders should pay an amount in Rs.2,00,000 (Rupees Two Lakh only) towards Earnest Money Deposit (EMD).

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

technicalCriterionList.description: The Bidder should have satisfactorily executed the work of Routine or Preventive and Breakdown Electrical maintenance works in any public private thermal Power Stations of capacity 210 MW or above in the field of LT or HT switchgears, LT Motors, Transformers as a Prime Contractor in a single work order for an amount of not less than Rs.50.05 Lakhs Exclusive GST in any ONE year during preceding FIVE years 2021-22 to 2025-26. The intending bidder shall submit the work order and relevant work done or work completion certificate as a documentary proof issued by the Competent Authority. On demand original shall be produced for verification.Work done value of previous years shall be given weightage of 10% per year to bring them to the present price level of the financial year, in which tenders are invited

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Work order and work done certificate

technicalCriterionList.description: The intending bidder shall hold a valid Class-I or above Electrical contractor license issued by Electrical Inspectorate of GOK

The Bidder should have achieved an minimum annual financial turnover of Rs.200.21 Lakhs Exclusive GST in any TWO years of the preceding FIVE financial years 2021-22 to 2025-26.The Bidder shall furnish the Profit and Loss statement duly certified by chartered accountant as a documentary proof. On demand original shall be produced for verification.Financial turnover of previous years shall be given weightage of 10% per year to bring them to present price level of the financial year in which tenders are invited
